Drinks logged
Caffeine: 5-hour half-life. Alcohol: Widmark estimate from your latest weigh-in, clearing at a flat 0.015%/hour — the two use separate vertical scales since mg and BAC aren't comparable. Both assume the drink absorbs the moment it's logged (real absorption takes 30–60 min, so early peaks read high), and both use typical figures for each serving rather than what was actually in your glass.

The BAC number is a rough estimate and must not be used to decide whether you're okay to drive.
